body.title: Add ReviewReportDocgenCall and renderReviewReport
body.summary: New module src/workflow/review-round/review-report.ts: ReviewReportDocgenCall{reviewId,round} (sc4's interfaceSketch), and renderReviewReport(call, findings, reconciliation, priorFindings) composing a Markdown string from findings (+ reconciliation annotations scoped to the adjacent round pair, for round>1) and persisting it under the reviewed repository's .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ directory, returning the written path. Reuses s3's established conventions verbatim: requireValidReviewId-style literal-identifier validation, RangeError for an invalid round (matching runReviewRound), resolveRepoPath-based canonical repo resolution (never process cwd), and a _setReviewReportDepsForTests test seam. Includes the compile-time typecheck fixture (__type-tests__/review-report.typecheck.ts) proving ReviewReportDocgenCall's exact field shape.
acceptanceChecks: ReviewReportDocgenCall and renderReviewReport are exported exactly as contractDetails/dataModelChanges specify, with the corrected four-parameter signature (call, findings, reconciliation, priorFindings) per the resolved open question
renderReviewReport validates call.reviewId (literal-identifier) and call.round (positive integer, RangeError) before any path join or filesystem write, per errorPaths

renderReviewReport resolves the reviewed repository through the canonical resolver (never the daemon process's own cwd) and writes exactly one Markdown file under its .insrc/tmp/<call.reviewId>/ directory, returning that path
the typecheck fixture rejects an added/removed ReviewReportDocgenCall key via @ts-expect-error / Equal<keyof ReviewReportDocgenCall,...>
a rejecting filesystem write propagates its rejection unchanged rather than returning a path to a file that was never written

tests.name: renderReviewReport writes a persisted Markdown file under the review's own .insrc/tmp/<reviewId>/ directory and returns its path
